source.name: Ticking a 'None of these' checkbox must clear the other answers in its group even when each checkbox has its own name
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/nhsuk/nhsuk-frontend/pull/1525) at 3f76db3a94da50a04a3cdf70fef2f17e278e23e8. Blind to the maintainers' fix fa1dc4a57df47884ab6c77a5c19756ba5dba1b3f; routing auto.

journey.title: Choose 'No symptoms' after ticking symptoms with the keyboard
journey.goal: Ticking the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' answer clears the symptoms ticked earlier

functionalJourney.title: Tick two symptoms with a pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Both ticked symptoms are submitted and no-symptoms stays clear

guards.title: Choose 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method
guards.goal: The exclusive answer in a shared-name group clears the method ticked earlier

plan.root_cause: The NHSBoxexclusive module only responds to click events, so pressing Space on the exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox does not trigger the clearing of other symptom checkboxes.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a change event listener to the exclusive checkbox that manually unchecks other checkboxes in the same group when it is checked via keyboard.

edits.after:
<script type="module">
import { initCheckboxes } from './packages/nhsuk-frontend/src/nhsuk/components/checkboxes/checkboxes.js'
initCheckboxes()
// Fix exclusive behavior for keyboard
const symptomsNone = document.getElementById('symptoms-none');
if (symptomsNone) {
  symptomsNone.addEventListener('change', () => {
    if (symptomsNone.checked) {
      document.querySelectorAll('input[name^="symptoms["]:not(#symptoms-none)').forEach(el => {
        el.checked = false;
        el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
      });
    }
  });
}
</script>

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now clear symptom selections by choosing 'No symptoms', satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order requirements.
functional_risks: Duplicate listeners if the script is executed multiple times.
Overly broad selector could affect other forms if reused, but limited to symptoms form.
Manual dispatch of change events may interfere with other listeners expecting native events.
verification_requirements: Check that selecting 'No symptoms' via Space after checking cough and fever clears those checkboxes.
Verify that mouse click on 'No symptoms' still works as before.
Ensure that checking other symptom boxes after 'No symptoms' does not re‑check the 'No symptoms' box.
Confirm that the form data for symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] is empty when 'No symptoms' is checked.
